name: io.github.wildcherrycasa/cosmos-authority
description: Spend authorization for AI agents with signed, offline-verifiable receipts. Wraps paid MCP tools: ALLOW forwards, DENY never executes. Hands the agent a rail to execute on (Writ by reference) and never moves money itself.

environment_variables.name: COSMOS_URL
environment_variables.description: Cosmos API base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8787

environment_variables.name: COSMOS_GRANT_ID
environment_variables.description: The grant this agent spends under

environment_variables.name: COSMOS_MCP_UPSTREAM
environment_variables.description: Command line of the upstream MCP server to wrap, e.g. "npx some-paid-tool-server"
